title: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions
method: Historical analysis; nearest-run counterfactuals; proposed heuristics simulated.
limitations: Counterfactuals are estimates; intervening code and hardware confound results.

title: Does Using Bazel Help Speed Up Continuous Integration Builds?
method: CPU-controlled containers; ten repetitions for parallelism, five for cache strategies.
limitations: Compilation only; cache emulation used FUSE without compression; excludes unbuildable projects.
metric_context: Speedup is clean or one-worker compilation time divided by candidate compilation time, not end-to-end CI speedup.

title: Accelerating Continuous Integration by Caching Environments and Inferring Dependencies
method: Historical streams plus seven-project replay: no acceleration, L1, L1+L2; ten repetitions.
limitations: Requires pinned dependencies, resettable tests and sufficient trace coverage; coarse test processes limit gains.
